<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#110c12" />
  <meta name="description" content="No Limiar do Finito — prólogo jogável. Explore Limiante, um labirinto de ruínas, memórias e algo à espreita." />
  <title>No Limiar do Finito — Teste 61 · Inventário dos três baús</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="data:text/css;base64," />
<style>
/* O algarismo final foi gravado antes da chegada de P. */
.code-fixed-digit{display:inline-block;color:#ffe4a2;text-shadow:0 0 10px #d89053,0 0 20px #9d6338;border-bottom:2px solid #9e754b;padding:0 3px 1px;min-width:.7em}
/* TESTE 49: quadros de pesadelo, sem caixas de texto de retorno. */
#death-screen.nightmare-screen,#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen{
 width:100%;height:100%;min-height:100%;max-width:none;max-height:none;
 margin:0;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;
 display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
 background:#050309;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
#death-screen.nightmare-screen::before,#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen.nightmare-visual::before{
 content:"";display:block!important;position:absolute;inset:-16px;
 background-image:var(--nightmare-bg);background-position:center;background-size:cover;
 filter:blur(16px) brightness(.36) saturate(.75);opacity:.93;
 pointer-events:none;animation:none!important;transform:none;
}
#death-screen.nightmare-screen::after,#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen::after{content:"";display:block!important;position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#07030870,transparent 20%,transparent 80%,#07030870);box-shadow:inset 0 0 55px #040305c0;}
#death-screen .nightmare-foreground,#glitch-screen .nightmare-foreground{
 position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;
 object-fit:contain;object-position:center;image-rendering:pixelated;
}
#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen:not(.nightmare-visual){background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#421018,#110408 70%,#000)}
#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen:not(.nightmare-visual)::before{background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 8px,rgba(215,35,59,.15) 9px 11px,transparent 12px 23px);filter:none;opacity:1;inset:0;animation:glitchScan .3s steps(3) infinite!important}
#glitch-screen .glitch-hebrew{position:relative;z-index:3;margin:0 10px;padding:15px;font-size:clamp(24px,4.8vw,55px)}
#glitch-screen.nightmare-visual .nightmare-foreground{animation:nightmareImpact .15s steps(2,end) 1}
@keyframes nightmareImpact{0%{transform:translateX(-5px);filter:contrast(2) hue-rotate(14deg)}60%{transform:translateX(4px);filter:contrast(1.4)}100%{transform:none;filter:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#glitch-screen.nightmare-visual .nightmare-foreground{animation:none!important}}

/* TESTE 50 — Melancolia: tratamento visual de duas cenas, sem modificar suas artes-fonte. */
#death-screen.nightmare-screen,
#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen {
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;
  min-width:100%;min-height:100%;max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important;
  margin:0!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0;
  overflow:hidden!important;box-shadow:none!important;
  isolation:isolate;
}
/* O fundo continua preenchendo a área de jogo inclusive durante carregamento de imagem. */
#death-screen.nightmare-screen::before,
#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen.nightmare-visual::before {
  position:absolute;inset:-10px;opacity:1;
  filter:grayscale(.45) saturate(.46) brightness(.56) blur(7px);
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;transform:none;
}
#death-screen.nightmare-screen .nightmare-foreground,
#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen.nightmare-visual .nightmare-foreground {
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;
  min-width:100%;min-height:100%;max-width:none;max-height:none;
  display:block;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;
  filter:grayscale(.34) saturate(.55) sepia(.08) brightness(.75) contrast(1.08);
  image-rendering:pixelated;
}
/* A arte vertical do Samael é enquadrada por cima: o rosto e a mão preenchem o panorama. */
#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen.nightmare-visual #nightmare-samael {
  object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;
  filter:grayscale(.40) saturate(.56) sepia(.05) brightness(.72) contrast(1.14);
  animation:nightmare-sombre-reveal .16s steps(2,end) 1 both;
}
@keyframes nightmare-sombre-reveal {
  0% {transform:translateX(-4px);opacity:.45}
  60% {transform:translateX(3px);opacity:.83}
  100% {transform:translateX(0);opacity:1}
}
/* Véu azul-acinzentado e vinheta discreta para um clima de perda, não terror estridente. */
#death-screen.nightmare-screen::after,
#glitch-screen.nightmare-screen::after {
  z-index:3;content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(23,35,54,.17) 0%,rgba(24,30,48,.08) 38%,rgba(4,6,17,.73) 100%),
             radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 32%,rgba(6,8,21,.48) 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 45px rgba(3,5,13,.68);
}
/* Texto integrado à imagem de captura, sem reintroduzir o aviso de retorno. */
#death-screen.nightmare-screen .nightmare-message {
  position:absolute;z-index:5;left:8%;right:8%;bottom:5%;
  width:auto;margin:0;padding:13px 14px;
  font-family:var(--mono),monospace;
  font-size:clamp(10px,1.7vw,17px);line-height:1.6;
  letter-spacing:.012em;font-weight:400;text-align:center;
  color:#e0dce8;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #050411,0 2px 12px #000;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(7,10,23,.55) 15%,rgba(7,10,23,.62) 85%,transparent);
  animation:nightmare-message-enter .5s ease-out both;
}
#death-screen.nightmare-screen .nightmare-message span {display:block;color:#b9b5c9}
@keyframes nightmare-message-enter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #glitch-screen.nightmare-screen.nightmare-visual #nightmare-samael,
  #death-screen.nightmare-screen .nightmare-message{animation:none!important}
}

/* Teste 61: cena de captura permanece ate toque/click. */
#death-screen{cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
#death-screen .death-instruction{display:block;margin-top:18px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#eed6c8;font:600 11px/1.6 monospace;animation:death-prompt-pulse 1.7s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes death-prompt-pulse{50%{opacity:.38}}
#dialog-screen .continue{transition:opacity .15s}
</style>
<style>
/* Teste 56: inventário visual exclusivo, sem diário de registros. */
.lim-inventory-screen{width:min(760px,92%);max-height:94%;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:26px 30px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#251923,#130f19 65%,#21171e);border:1px solid #776070;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #000b}
.lim-inventory-screen h2{font-family:var(--serif),Georgia,serif;color:#e6d3bd;font-size:clamp(24px,3.8vw,35px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;margin:2px 0}
.lim-inventory-screen .lim-inv-hint{font-size:12px;color:#b7a4a9;text-align:center;max-width:500px;line-height:1.65;margin:0}
.lim-items{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.lim-item{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:11px;border:1px solid #5c4352;background:linear-gradient(#20151e,#151017);text-align:center;min-height:208px}
.lim-item.found{border-color:#967e64;background:linear-gradient(#29202b,#17121a)}
.lim-item-img{height:140px;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#39303a44,transparent 72%)}
.lim-item-img img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 10px #080509)}
.lim-item-unknown{font:36px Georgia,serif;color:#675565;opacity:.8}
.lim-item strong{font:13px Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#e5caa9}
.lim-item:not(.found) strong{color:#887987}
.lim-inventory-screen .close{margin-top:4px;min-width:165px}
@media(max-width:580px){.lim-inventory-screen{padding:14px 10px}.lim-items{gap:5px}.lim-item{padding:5px;min-height:140px}.lim-item-img{height:90px}.lim-item strong{font-size:10px}.lim-inventory-screen .lim-inv-hint{font-size:10px}}
</style>
<style>
/* Teste 56 — conversa seletiva de Lumini, separada dos diálogos aprovados. */
.lumini-questions-screen{width:min(680px,88%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;padding:26px 32px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#241826,#100c16 70%);border:1px solid #795b87;box-shadow:0 0 48px #11031c,0 26px 70px #000d}
.lumini-questions-screen h2{font:500 clamp(23px,3.5vw,34px)/1.25 Georgia,serif;color:#e8d4eb;margin:0}
.lumini-questions-screen p{font:12px/1.7 var(--mono),monospace;color:#bea9c8;margin:0}
.lumini-choices{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:6px}
.lumini-choices button{width:100%;text-align:left;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;border-color:#65516d;background:#211825;color:#e4d8e7;padding:14px 17px}
.lumini-choices button:not(:disabled):hover{background:#3b2746;border-color:#b28cc8}
.lumini-choices button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default;color:#a59aab}
.lumini-questions-screen .lumini-back{align-self:center;min-width:180px;font-size:10px;margin-top:4px}
@media(max-height:500px){.lumini-questions-screen{padding:14px 19px;gap:7px}.lumini-choices{gap:5px}.lumini-choices button{padding:7px 12px}}
</style>
<style>
/* TESTE 61 — A CHEGADA DE LUMINI: direção discreta e silêncio como tensão. */
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence{
  position:relative;width:100%;max-width:none;height:100%;max-height:none;
  margin:0;padding:0;border:0;box-shadow:none;overflow:hidden;
  display:block;background:#05070c;isolation:isolate;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence::before,#glitch-screen.samael-sequence::after{content:none!important;display:none!important}
#overlay:has(#glitch-screen.samael-sequence:not(.hidden)){
  background:transparent;backdrop-filter:none;
}
#viewport:has(#glitch-screen.samael-sequence:not(.hidden)) #hud{opacity:0}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-memory-frame{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:fill;
  z-index:1;opacity:1;image-rendering:pixelated;transition:opacity 1.25s ease;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-vision{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#2b2b36 0%,#10131c 53%,#05050b 100%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.7s ease;overflow:hidden;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-portrait-aura{
  position:absolute;width:100%;height:120%;object-fit:cover;
  filter:blur(42px) grayscale(.9) saturate(.4) brightness(.24) hue-rotate(12deg);
  opacity:.75;transform:scale(1.65);
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-gaze-portrait{
  position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(69%,420px);height:min(88%,420px);
  object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;
  filter:grayscale(.65) saturate(.53) sepia(.08) brightness(.81) contrast(1.10);
  box-shadow:0 0 80px 45px #10121b9a;
  transform:scale(1.01);transform-origin:center 37%;
  transition:transform 6.3s linear,filter 6.3s linear;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-vision::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;z-index:3;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 24%,#070913a5 83%,#030308e8 100%);
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="gaze"] .samael-vision,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="message"] .samael-vision,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="hold"] .samael-vision,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="rupture"] .samael-vision{opacity:1}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="gaze"] .samael-memory-frame,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="message"] .samael-memory-frame,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="hold"] .samael-memory-frame,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="rupture"] .samael-memory-frame{opacity:0}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="gaze"] .samael-gaze-portrait,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="message"] .samael-gaze-portrait,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="hold"] .samael-gaze-portrait{
  transform:scale(1.25);filter:grayscale(.85) saturate(.38) sepia(.04) brightness(.72) contrast(1.14);
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence .glitch-hebrew{
  position:absolute;z-index:5;bottom:11%;left:6%;width:88%;margin:0!important;
  padding:10px 16px;min-height:1.7em;display:block;text-align:center;
  font:500 clamp(22px,3.6vw,43px)/1.55 Georgia,serif;
  letter-spacing:.015em;color:#d7d7e5;text-shadow:0 1px 15px #13192b,0 0 3px #b3afc9;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#10111cc4 17%,#10111cc4 83%,transparent);
  border:0;opacity:0;animation:none!important;pointer-events:none;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="message"] .glitch-hebrew,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="hold"] .glitch-hebrew,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="rupture"] .glitch-hebrew{opacity:1}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-rupture-overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:7;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 8px,#b8adcc27 9px 10px,transparent 11px 17px);
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="rupture"] .samael-rupture-overlay{
  opacity:1;animation:samael-signal-tear .12s steps(2,end) 3;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="rupture"] .samael-gaze-portrait{
  animation:samael-portrait-tear .115s steps(2,end) 4;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="rupture"] .glitch-hebrew{
  animation:samael-text-tear .12s steps(2,end) 3!important;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-blackout{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;background:#000;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="blackout"] .samael-blackout{opacity:1}
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="blackout"] .samael-vision,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="blackout"] .samael-memory-frame,
#glitch-screen.samael-sequence[data-phase="blackout"] .glitch-hebrew{opacity:0}
@keyframes samael-signal-tear{0%{transform:translateX(-7px)}33%{transform:translateX(5px)}66%{transform:translateX(-3px)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}
@keyframes samael-portrait-tear{0%{transform:translate(-5px,2px) scale(1.25);filter:grayscale(.93) contrast(1.8)}50%{transform:translate(5px,-2px) scale(1.28);filter:grayscale(.5) hue-rotate(35deg)}100%{transform:translate(0) scale(1.25)}}
@keyframes samael-text-tear{0%{transform:translateX(-4px)}50%{transform:translateX(4px)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-vision,
  #glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-memory-frame,
  #glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-gaze-portrait{transition:none!important}
  #glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-rupture-overlay,
  #glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-gaze-portrait,
  #glitch-screen.samael-sequence .glitch-hebrew{animation:none!important}
}
/* O HUD conserva somente avisos contextuais de interação, sem lista de atalhos. */
#hud .hud-bottom{justify-content:flex-start}
#hud .hud-bottom .prompt{max-width:min(100%,480px)}
/* Nova categoria COMANDO recolhida dentro do PAUSE. */
#pause-screen .pause-commands{
  width:100%;border:1px solid #785567;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#231920,#141218);
  text-align:left;margin:1px 0 4px;
}
#pause-screen .pause-commands summary{
  cursor:pointer;list-style:none;padding:12px 15px;font:600 11px/1.5 var(--mono);
  color:#e5c8ca;letter-spacing:.15em;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
}
#pause-screen .pause-commands summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#pause-screen .pause-commands summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #e8c99f;outline-offset:2px}
#pause-screen .pause-commands summary .command-chevron{font-size:14px;color:#b9999b;transition:transform .2s}
#pause-screen .pause-commands[open] summary .command-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg)}
#pause-screen .pause-commands .pause-commands-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:9px 12px;
  border-top:1px solid #5f414f;padding:14px 15px 17px;font:11px/1.5 var(--mono);
}
#pause-screen .pause-commands-grid span{color:#d8cdd0}
#pause-screen .pause-commands-grid kbd{font:600 10px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.03em;
  color:#efd4a7;white-space:nowrap;text-align:right}
#pause-screen .pause-controls-caption{grid-column:1/-1;color:#aa91a0;font:9px/1.5 var(--mono);padding-top:4px}
#pause-screen{gap:10px;padding:24px 28px;max-height:94%}
#pause-screen h2{margin:4px 0 8px}
@media(max-width:580px){
 #pause-screen{width:95%;padding:18px 17px;gap:8px}
 #pause-screen .pause-commands summary{padding:10px 12px}
 #pause-screen .pause-commands .pause-commands-grid{padding:10px 12px;gap:7px 8px}
 #glitch-screen.samael-sequence .samael-gaze-portrait{width:min(75%,360px);height:auto;max-height:80%}
 #glitch-screen.samael-sequence .glitch-hebrew{bottom:10%;width:94%;left:3%;padding:7px;font-size:clamp(19px,4vw,29px)}
}
/* Em retrato, o menu de pausa ocupa a tela do aparelho para que COMANDO seja legível. */
@media(max-width:580px) and (orientation:portrait){
 #viewport:has(#pause-screen:not(.hidden)){overflow:visible!important;isolation:auto!important}
 #overlay:has(#pause-screen:not(.hidden)){
   position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;padding:12px;align-items:center;
   background:rgba(7,5,11,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
 }
 #pause-screen:not(.hidden){width:min(420px,100%);max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px)!important;overflow-y:auto}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="backdrop"></div>
  <main class="shell">
    <header class="masthead">
      <div class="brand"><span class="sigil" aria-hidden="true">✣</span><div><div class="eyebrow">UM FRAGMENTO DO UNIVERSO</div><h1>NO LIMIAR DO <em>FINITO</em></h1></div></div>
      <div class="edition">PRÓLOGO · TESTE 61 · TRÊS MEMÓRIAS <span> / </span> 08.11.2026</div>
    </header>
    <section class="game-wrap" aria-label="Área do jogo">
      <div id="viewport">
        <canvas id="game" width="960" height="540" aria-label="Jogo 2D de exploração: use as setas ou WASD para movimentar P e E para interagir."></canvas>
        <div class="film-grain"></div>
        <div class="scanlines"></div>
        <div id="hud" class="hud hidden">
          <div class="hud-upper"><div class="locale"><span class="micro">LOCALIZAÇÃO</span><strong id="location">Limiante</strong></div><div class="inventory"><span class="micro">CIFRAS RECUPERADAS</span><strong><span id="clue-count">0</span><span class="sep"> / 3</span></strong></div></div>
          <div class="hud-bottom"><span id="prompt" class="prompt hidden"></span></div>
        </div>
        <div id="mobileControls" class="mobile-controls hidden"><div class="dpad"><button data-move="up" aria-label="Para cima">↑</button><button data-move="left" aria-label="Esquerda">←</button><button data-move="down" aria-label="Para baixo">↓</button><button data-move="right" aria-label="Direita">→</button></div><button class="act" id="touchAction">E · Examinar</button></div>
        <div id="overlay" class="overlay">
          <section id="start-screen" class="start-screen panel" role="dialog" aria-label="Iniciar jogo">
            <div class="red-rule"></div><div class="start-rune">✧</div>
            <div class="meta-label">UM PEQUENO RELATO FORA DO TEMPO</div>
            <h2>O LABIRINTO<br><i>ENTRE O QUE RESTOU</i></h2>
            <p>As pedras lembram. As raízes escutam.<br>Você acorda em um lugar que não deveria existir.</p>
            <button id="start-btn" class="primary">INICIAR O PRÓLOGO <span>↗</span></button>
            <div class="start-controls">W A S D / SETAS <span>—</span> CAMINHAR <span>·</span> SHIFT <span>—</span> CORRER <span>·</span> E <span>—</span> INTERAGIR</div>
            <div class="start-footnote">Versão 61 · Limiante · Céu Dourado · A Cena Incompleta · Biblioteca</div>
          </section>
          <section id="dialog-screen" class="dialogue panel hidden" role="dialog" aria-live="polite">
            <div class="dialog-portrait"><img id="dialog-image" alt="Retrato do personagem" /></div>
            <div class="dialog-body"><span id="speaker" class="speaker"></span><p id="dialog-text"></p><span class="continue">ENTER / E — CONTINUAR <span>◆</span></span></div>
          </section>
          <section id="lumini-questions-screen" class="lumini-questions-screen panel hidden" role="dialog" aria-label="Perguntas ao desconhecido">
            <div class="micro">UM ENCONTRO NO LIMIANTE</div>
            <h2 id="lumini-questions-title">???</h2>
            <p id="lumini-questions-status">Escolha três perguntas. Cada resposta será dada uma única vez.</p>
            <div class="lumini-choices">
              <button class="secondary" id="lumini-question-place">1 · O que é esse lugar?</button>
              <button class="secondary" id="lumini-question-why">2 · Por que eu estou aqui?</button>
              <button class="secondary" id="lumini-question-name">3 · Quem é você?</button>
            </div>
            <button class="secondary lumini-back" id="lumini-questions-back">VOLTAR · ESC</button>
          </section>
